mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (a restrictive threshold), or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105 and HOUST < 1200, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (INDPRO * HOUST) and 60-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in CPIAUCSL above 250 signals accelerating inflation, which may trigger further rate hikes and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising), when CPIAUCSL > 250, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise above 1200 and payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 147000, it signals a labor-demand mismatch that may indicate economic fragility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200 and PAYEMS < 147000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * PAYEMS) and 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate above 4.2% signals cooling labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth rate below 2.0% and positive), when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is greater than -0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
